results.text: Role of Perindopril in Mitigating Doxorubicin's Vascular Toxicity in a Rat Model. Doxorubicin (DOX), a widely used anthracycline in cancer therapy, is associated with significant cardiovascular toxicity. While its cardiotoxic effects are well documented, the mechanisms and prevention of DOX-induced vascular toxicity remain insufficiently explored. Adipocytes have the ability to express angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 receptors (ACE2) and several adipocytokines. These expressions could lead to the activation of a cytokine storm, which in turn promotes the development of cardiovascular diseases.
